{{Quote|Permission granted to land on Platform 3-2-7.|Cloud car pilot, to Han Solo and the ''Millennium Falcon''|<ref name="Episode 5">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
'''Platform 327''' was a landing platform in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] with its crew, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] landed on this platform to meet [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] after escaping the [[Hoth asteroid field/Legends|Hoth asteroid field]]. Sometime later, the Falcon took off from the platform with the same crew, but this time without [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and with [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] piloting it along with [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]].

==Behind the scenes==
Perhaps not coincidentally, 327 was also the designation of the particular Death Star landing bay which captured the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].
